    //==
    // Joints between two surfaces.
    //
    // Operators whose result is a feature running ALONG the curve where two shapes
    // meet, rather than a modified version of either. All four take the second shape
    // as a cutting or guiding surface, not as a solid to be merged. Fidelity is the
    // chamfer family's above: a lower bound where the two surfaces cross at a right
    // angle or near it, and not a bound as they approach parallel.

    // A rounded pipe of the given radius running along the curve where the two

    PipeDistance(a: Number, b: Number, radius: Number): Number
        => Vector2D(a, b).Magnitude - radius;
